inputs.text: Wake up. They want you to believe this is just a harmless grassroots hustle by some local organizers and a guy named Corb Lund starting something called Water Not Coal last month. Don't fall for the cover story. The whole petition tables setup, collecting signatures to supposedly call on the Government of Alberta to “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration”? It's a classic distraction, a manufactured script managed by the hidden elites to distract us from the real realignment of resources. When they tell you it's about protecting southern Alberta’s watershed, you know the exact opposite is true. They are orchestrating this entire theatre behind the scenes to lock down total control over what is really moving through that region. Do not buy the official narrative being pushed at asmith@medicinehatnews.com.
